text: The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 30 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank Mandiri, number 1240007719356, in the name of Nusantara Tech Supplies Ltd.
Late payment accrues interest of 1.5% per month on the overdue amount.
A change of the payment account takes effect only after the Supplier sends a formal letter signed by a director and the Buyer verifies it by telephone on the registered number.
A request to change the account made only on an invoice or by email has no effect.
The Supplier delivers within 14 calendar days of receiving a purchase order.
Partial deliveries are allowed; the remainder is delivered and invoiced once received.
